title: Add another person to an E-Toll Account
summary: Learn how to give other people access to your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account.
intro:
You can arrange for other people to have access to your Transport for NSW E-Toll Account:

The additional contacts:
who_can_apply: You must be the account holder.
what_you_need: The contact details of the person you want to add (you must have their permission)

how_to_steps.text: raise an enquiry in your E-Toll Account
visit a Service NSW Centre with your supporting documents.

internal_links.text: Manage an additional contact on an E-Toll Account

faqs.q: Who can add another person to an E-Toll Account?
faqs.a: You must be the account holder.

faqs.q: What do I need to add another person to my E-Toll Account?
faqs.a: You need your account details and the contact details of the person you want to add. You must also have their permission.

faqs.q: How can I add another person to my E-Toll Account?
faqs.a: You can raise an enquiry in your E-Toll Account, call 13 18 65, or visit a Service NSW Centre with your supporting documents.
